title: SIU names man, 38, killed in Oakville standoff
article: An armed man killed in a confrontation with police had recently returned to Ontario from B.C. after losing or leaving his job.
Steve Remian, 38, died after being shot several times by three officers, two of them tactical unit members, early Saturday in a park in the town's east end.
Reports said one of those bullets is believed to have hit Remian in the head.
Remian had moved to B.C. to work and recently returned to Oakville, where he lived in the past and has family.
The province's Special Investigations Unit is investigating the death and spokesperson Rose Bliss said an autopsy was performed yesterday and some results might be revealed today.
Police began looking for Remian and his car after receiving a call from a person at a Tim Hortons about an hour before the shooting.
Bliss said the man was reported to be acting strangely and threatened to harm himself and others. The caller had also seen a rifle.
